questions.description: In Python, what is a class?
questions.Option1: A blueprint that defines the attributes and methods shared by all its objects
questions.Option2: A container that can only store numbers
questions.Option3: A function that always returns a new object

questions.Option2: Every time any method of the class is called

questions.Option3: Inheriting methods from a parent class

questions.title: Shared Squad List Output
questions.description: This snippet builds two Squad objects and adds one member to each. What does it print?
questions.codesnippet:
class Squad:
    members = []

    def add(self, name):
        self.members.append(name)

a = Squad()
b = Squad()
a.add("Riya")
b.add("Om")
print(a.members)
print(b.members)

questions.title: Shared Queue Across Instances
questions.description: Queue keeps items as a class attribute. Two Queue objects push values as shown. What does the snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
class Queue:
    items = []

    def __init__(self, label):
        self.label = label

    def push(self, x):
        self.items.append(x)

p = Queue("P")
q = Queue("Q")
p.push(1)
p.push(2)
q.push(3)
print(len(p.items))
print(q.items[-1])
